name: Edith Corrine Graham
bioAdditions: FamilySearch: Edith Corrine Grammes, daughter of Cyrus Randolph Gramm (1829-1902) and Martha L. Robinson; married John V. Heffernan in Manhattan 4 May 1914 (NYC index as "Edith C. Graham"); died Wilkes-Barre 6 Nov 1938; buried Fairview Cemetery, Danville (S1).
